pages.text: Iron nuggets in the corners, redstone block above, iron bars at the remaining edges, and a crafting table in the center.

pages.title: Choose an Output
pages.text: Right-click to open the Constructor. Click a desired output item onto the $(thing)Template$() slot. Your item stays on the cursor.$(br2)With JEI installed, drag its item directly onto that slot. Right-click the template to clear it.

pages.title: Recipe Alternatives
pages.text: The list shows crafting recipes that use one ingredient type. Click a row to select it; scroll for more.$(br2)Vanilla stone bricks use 4 stone and make 4 bricks. A modded recipe using cracked bricks appears as another option. Actual recipe quantities are preserved.

pages.title: Supply Materials
pages.text: One real inventory slot buffers the chosen ingredient. All faces except the output accept items, so three horizontal supply belts can feed it together.$(br2)The dropper face is the output and points away from you on placement. Inputs stay in the buffer until a batch is fully funded.

pages.title: Power and Results
pages.text: The buffer holds $(thing)5,000 RF$() and refills without a per-tick limit. Each output item costs $(thing)500 RF$(). Supply power on any input face.$(br2)Large batches accumulate their charge across refills. Completed results and crafting remainders wait safely for output space.
